races.paceDynamic: Quercus will take this race forward as the only confirmed front runner, setting what should be a sustainable gallop over the sharp 6f trip. With The Gay Blade the only prominent runner likely to track him, there's minimal early pace pressure which creates a controlled tempo. This measured early pace will allow the large contingent of hold-up horses to get into contention, but the relatively short distance means they'll need to be produced at the right moment. This race shape clearly favours horses with tactical speed who can position handy or those hold-up performers with a proven sharp turn of foot over 6f.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Controlled Pace Suits Closers
scenarios.trigger: If Quercus sets uncontested fractions and the pace doesn't quicken until late
scenarios.body: The large field of hold-up horses get their preferred scenario with plenty to aim at in the closing stages. Sharp 6f specialists with proven finishing kicks will thrive in the dash from the 2f pole.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Front Rank Dominance
scenarios.trigger: If Quercus maintains his advantage and The Gay Blade provides company in the early stages
scenarios.body: The two pace angles control the race from the front with the field strung out behind them. Quercus's class edge and The Gay Blade's recent winning form prove decisive as closers leave their run too late.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Tactical Speed Prevails
scenarios.trigger: If the early pace becomes messy with several horses trying to get handy positions
scenarios.body: A moderate gallop turns into a sprint finish where horses with natural pace have the edge. Those able to travel strongly into the straight and quicken will benefit from the tactical nature.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Chaos Benefits Outsiders
scenarios.trigger: If Quercus doesn't handle the return from a 170-day break or gets headed early
scenarios.body: The pace scenario collapses entirely creating a muddling affair where form gets turned upside down. Lightly-weighted horses with claims on their best form can capitalize on the chaos.

watchPoints.text: Quercus's fitness after 170 days off could see him fold tamely if the layoff has left him short of peak condition
The Gay Blade with inexperienced 5lb claimer Cara Tuke who may struggle with tactical decisions in a competitive handicap
Fircombe Hall attempting quick turnaround after running just 9 days ago which could catch up with the 8-year-old
Several 3lb claimers including Ethan Tindall and Oliver Carmichael whose inexperience could cost their mounts in tight finishes
Bottom weights Bernie The Bear, World Of Darcy, Nazca and Gimmieminnie all capable of outrunning odds if pace scenario suits

races.paceDynamic: Clansman will take the field along from the front with no other confirmed pace-setters, giving him an uncontested lead in this small six-runner field. Moon Sniper and Roger Henry may press forward from prominent positions but are unlikely to challenge Clansman's early dominance. The sustainable pace will allow the three hold-up horses (Patrol, Mao Shang Wong, Analogical) to get into contention, but they'll need the leaders to weaken significantly over this stamina-testing trip. This race shape strongly favours front-runners and prominent racers who can capitalize on the uncontested pace.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Clansman Controls Throughout
scenarios.trigger: If Clansman maintains his uncontested lead without folding in the straight.
scenarios.body: The veteran gets first run on his rivals and his recent good form suggests he can sustain the gallop to the line. Front-running tactics prove decisive with insufficient pace pressure early.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Late Surge Succeeds
scenarios.trigger: If the pace becomes too slow and the hold-up horses get perfect splits in the straight.
scenarios.body: Analogical and Mao Shang Wong benefit from Sir Mark Prescott's patient tactics and O'Meara's timing respectively. The lack of early pace sets up their finishing kicks perfectly.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Prominent Tracker Strikes
scenarios.trigger: If Moon Sniper or Roger Henry can stalk Clansman and outstay him in the final furlong.
scenarios.body: The prominent runners get the best of both worlds - avoiding pace pressure while staying close enough to pounce. Their positioning proves tactically superior to both leaders and hold-up horses.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Clansman Folds Early
scenarios.trigger: If Clansman's 8-year-old legs give way despite the uncontested lead.
scenarios.body: The pace collapses completely leaving a sprint finish where class tells. The highest-rated horses benefit from the unexpectedly weak gallop throughout.

watchPoints.text: Watch if Moon Sniper shows any signs of rustiness early after 80 days off - could eliminate a major contender immediately.
Watch how aggressively Analogical is ridden with blinkers applied - may indicate tactical switch from hold-up to more forward position.
Watch if Roger Henry can get closer to Clansman early than usual - prominent position crucial with likely lack of pace.
Watch Clansman's jumping from the gates - needs clean start to establish his uncontested lead before others can organize.
Watch for any early pressure on Clansman from Moon Sniper or Roger Henry - could change the entire complexion of the race.

races.paceDynamic: Lindoro is the sole confirmed front runner and will dictate terms uncontested from the rail, creating a sustainable gallop rather than frantic early speed. With most runners holding up or racing prominently (Nebulon the exception), the pace will be steady to moderate through the early furlongs before quickening from the 2f pole. This measured tempo over 6f on the all-weather should favour horses that can quicken late and finish strongly. The race shape clearly benefits hold-up horses and prominent racers with finishing kicks over pure early speed types.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Horses Dominate
scenarios.trigger: If Lindoro sets a steady pace and the field bunches approaching the final 2f
scenarios.body: The moderate gallop allows patient riders to wind up their mounts late, with the best finishers overwhelming the leader in the final furlong. Gouken, Masai Angel and Slot all have the tactical speed to capitalise on this scenario.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Front Runner Survives
scenarios.trigger: If Lindoro kicks clear approaching the 2f pole and the closers fail to reel him in
scenarios.body: The uncontested leader gets first run and holds on as the hold-up horses make their moves too late on ground that may not be lightning fast. Lindoro's stamina advantage over 6f proves decisive.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Prominent Tracker Strikes
scenarios.trigger: If Nebulon tracks Lindoro closely and pounces at the perfect moment
scenarios.body: The only prominent runner uses his tactical position to strike at the ideal time, getting first run on the field while avoiding the leader's penalty of making all. His recent second over course and distance gives him a crucial edge.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Maiden Surprise Package
scenarios.trigger: If one of the lightly-raced runners shows significant improvement from debut runs
scenarios.body: April Diamond or Alfa Impulsion demonstrate hidden ability that their limited exposed form doesn't reveal, capitalising on the steady pace to deliver a shock result. Their unknown quantities prove better than ratings suggest.

watchPoints.text: Watch for Lindoro getting an uncontested lead - if allowed to bowl along in front unchallenged he could prove very difficult to peg back
Monitor the market moves on April Diamond and Alfa Impulsion as both lightly-raced runners could hold significant improvement
Keep an eye on how quickly the field closes up behind Lindoro in the early stages - a bunched field favours the finishers
Check if Masai Angel and Kilfrush Desert show signs of needing the run after their lengthy absences from action
Watch Nebulon's position tracking the leader as his prominent style and course experience make him the key tactical threat

races.paceDynamic: Fille Unique will take this along from the gates with Bella Delizia, Perfect Price, Golden Havana, Regal Dream and Jane Of The Jungle all likely to race prominently in the opening exchanges. With six horses wanting to be handy, there's potential for a strong gallop despite the short trip, though none are confirmed tearaways. The substantial hold-up contingent of Territorial Star, Enter Sandman, Data Fata Secutus, O Fortuna and Nana's Boy George will be relying on the pace to set up. This race shape clearly favours the prominent racers who can avoid the early scrimmaging and hold prime positions without getting involved in a speed duel.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Prominent Domination
scenarios.trigger: If the early pace is strong but not suicidal among the forward division
scenarios.body: The handy horses get first run while the hold-up brigade struggle to pick up the pieces in a sprint finish. Those who can track the pace without getting embroiled benefit most.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Heaven
scenarios.trigger: If the prominent horses go too fast early and tie up
scenarios.body: The strong pace sets it up perfectly for the closers who come with late runs. Territorial Star and Enter Sandman's superior RPRs become crucial.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Messy Scramble
scenarios.trigger: If the early pace is moderate and they finish in a bunch
scenarios.body: The race becomes a cavalry charge where draw, luck in running and jockey skill matter most. Any style can win in a blanket finish.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Pace Collapse
scenarios.trigger: If Fille Unique doesn't lead or the prominent horses are cautious
scenarios.body: A slowly-run race turns into a 2f dash where the speediest horses have decisive advantages. The race falls apart tactically.

watchPoints.text: If Fille Unique doesn't break cleanly or gets headed early, the pace scenario changes dramatically
Golden Havana and Bella Delizia both drop in grade here which could make them hard to peg back if getting first run
Enter Sandman's finishing kick could be decisive if the prominent horses set it up with honest pace
Territorial Star needs the race to be run to suit but has class edge on ratings when fresh
The 5lb claims for Alex Jary and Taryn Langley could prove significant in a tight finish

races.paceDynamic: Call Me Betty, Blazing Son, and Lord Capulet will engage from the start, with Lord Capulet showing the most recent front-running form including three consecutive wins. This trio will set a strong gallop over 7f at Newcastle, stretching the field and testing stamina reserves. The sustained pace will expose any lack of fitness, particularly affecting those returning from long breaks like King's School (139 days) and Too Much (241 days). This pace setup strongly favours hold-up horses who can stay on strongly, with the prominent racers needing to be perfectly positioned to avoid getting caught between pace groups.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Strong Pace Suits Closers
scenarios.trigger: If the three leaders maintain honest fractions through the middle sections
scenarios.body: The sustained gallop will find out the stamina-shy and set up a finish for horses like The Green Man, Anthropologist, and Phoenix Of Dreams who can stay on powerfully. The hold-up brigade gets the perfect setup with plenty to aim at.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Prominent Holds Position
scenarios.trigger: If one of Criminal Shore, Ziggy's Condor, or Bobby Joe Leg can track the pace without over-racing
scenarios.body: They'll be ideally placed to strike when the leaders weaken, avoiding the traffic that may hinder the hold-up horses. Their tactical positioning proves decisive in a strongly-run race.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Leader Survives Pressure
scenarios.trigger: If Lord Capulet or Call Me Betty can resist the inevitable late challenges after setting strong fractions
scenarios.body: Recent form suggests Lord Capulet has the class and stamina to complete a four-timer despite carrying the tactical burden. The pace becomes more generous than expected, helping the front-runners' cause.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Pace Collapses Early
scenarios.trigger: If the three leaders go too fast early and come back to the field dramatically
scenarios.body: This would negate the stamina test and turn it into more of a sprint finish where lighter weights and fresh horses can capitalise. The tactical advantage shifts completely.

watchPoints.text: Lord Capulet's early position - if he settles worse than usual the pace could become unsustainably fast
King's School and Too Much for signs of fitness after 139 and 241-day breaks respectively
The gap between the three leaders and first prominent horse - if too big, it creates tactical complications
Anthropologist's early position as he often gets further back than ideal for his finishing kick
Call Me Betty's jumping - any tardiness from the stalls could end her front-running hopes immediately

races.paceDynamic: Esque Elegance will lead from the gates with Wheres The Crumpet and Martin's Brig providing early company, but this is predominantly a hold-up horse affair with 10 of 14 runners carrying that style. The sustainable early pace set by Esque Elegance will create a tactical race where the majority sit and wait, building into a sprint finish over the final two furlongs. With limited early pace and a crowded field of closers, this race shape strongly favours prominent runners who can position close to the speed and hold-up horses with proven finishing kicks.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Sustained Pace Holds
scenarios.trigger: If Esque Elegance maintains a steady gallop and the hold-up brigade leave their runs too late.
scenarios.body: The moderate early pace becomes unsustainable for closers as Esque Elegance and Wheres The Crumpet dominate the finish. Prominent runners who travelled in the first four benefit from the tactical positioning.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Late Surge Succeeds
scenarios.trigger: If the early pace collapses and creates a genuine sprint finish from the back.
scenarios.body: The hold-up horses with proven finishing speed get their ideal setup as the race becomes a dash. Starshot and Pebble Dash emerge from the pack with superior closing speed.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Mid-Race Acceleration
scenarios.trigger: If Wheres The Crumpet or Martin's Brig quicken the tempo approaching the home turn.
scenarios.body: The injection of pace stretches the field and catches late runners flat-footed while suiting those with tactical speed. Hold-up horses positioned handy benefit from the increased gallop.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Messy Scramble
scenarios.trigger: If the large field creates traffic problems and interference in the straight.
scenarios.body: The race becomes a lottery with positioning crucial as several hold-up horses struggle for clear runs. Horses drawn favourably or ridden prominently avoid the carnage.

watchPoints.text: Esque Elegance could steal this if the hold-up horses leave their challenges too late in a tactical affair
Traffic problems likely in the straight with 10 hold-up runners converging simultaneously
Take The A Train and Ridgemaster both show fading tendencies that could be exposed again
Starshot's excellent course record makes him dangerous if getting the expected sprint finish
Cloch Nua's 76-day absence is a concern but his course form suggests he handles the surface ideally
